newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moulin to issue 25 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Moulin to issue 25 million new shares.

text.p: Moulin International Ltd said on Friday it planned to raise HK$125 million by issuing 25 million new shares to its majority shareholder, which will place 40 million existing shares with institutions.
Moulin said KFL Ltd would subscribe to 25 million new shares at HK$5.25 each, a 5.4 percent discount to the share price before the shares were suspended from trade on Thursday.
KFL would also place 40 million existing shares with institutions at HK$5.25 a share, it said.
After the placement, KFL's 54.15 percent interest in Moulin would fall to about 45.57 percent, it said.
